subject: POC gating & stakeholder checklist — next steps and MAP
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@shopnexa.com>, Marcus Pierce <mpierce@shopnexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: POC gating + stakeholder checklist

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can map the POC gates and approvals.

Call highlights (short):
- Primary use case: product search ranking and personalization for ShopNexa storefront.
- Success metrics: click-through improvement (target +8%), latency under 150ms p95, and 95% accuracy on top-3 reranking when compared to baseline.
- Timeline preference: 4–6 week internal POC, target kickoff in the first week of December.

Proposed owners and asks (please confirm):
1) Economic buyer: Marcus Pierce — will confirm business sign-off and budget.
2) Procurement/legal: Procurement Team (procurement@shopnexa.com) — will need contract redlines and vendor terms.
3) Security/compliance: Rachel Kim from Redwood will coordinate SOC2 evidence and data handling docs.

Immediate next steps (MAP seed):
- Elena/Marcus: confirm economic buyer and preferred commercial terms by Fri 11/27.
- Procurement: share PO/contract process and standard SOW template.
- Redwood: push a draft MAP and POC SLA (attached) and propose milestone dates: kickoff 12/06, SUT+data load 12/10, initial eval 12/24, final review 01/07.

Attachments: shopnexa-map-v1.xlsx (MAP seed), redwood-poc-sla-draft.pdf (SLA draft).

Open questions for you:
- Is there a required data residency or tenant restriction for the POC?
- Any mandatory procurement steps (e.g., vendor questionnaire, security attestation) we should surface now?

If that looks reasonable I'll turn this into a live MAP (Drive link) and schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0194
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@shopnexa.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Pierce <mpierce@shopnexa.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@shopnexa.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: POC gating + stakeholder checklist

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and a couple of asks:  

- Confirming: Marcus is the economic buyer and will own the business OKRs and budget. He is copied.
- Procurement will run contracts; they want a vendor questionnaire and our standard terms redline before legal signs off (I copied them).
- Security: we need SOC2 Type II evidence and a short note on where logs & PII reside during the POC.

Timeline: the week of 12/06 works for kickoff. We prefer the POC to complete before our January board review (target 01/07 is good).

Also attaching our internal roles org doc for clarity (we'll share that file from our side). Can you send the specific list of security docs Procurement wants so they can prep?

On commercial points: procurement will ask for net-30 payment and an initial pilot credit request — happy to discuss but Marcus will confirm.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Product Operations | ShopNexa
elena.soto@shopnexa.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: MAP adjustments & recommended commercial levers (do not forward)

Internal note — quick suggestions after Elena's reply:
- Add a clear decision-criteria table to the MAP: business impact metric (CTR), performance (p95 latency), integration effort, and TCO estimate. This helps Marcus sign off.
- Offer a 30% pilot credit for the initial 4-week POC (we have runway in EMEA credits), but hide the exact number until legal/procurement asks.
- Recommend a canary rollout during the POC: 10% traffic/1 hour window for two consecutive days to validate KPI uplift without full exposure.
- Rachel: prepare SOC2 Type II attestation + a short Data Flow diagram (redwood-poc-dataflow.pdf stub) for procurement.

I'll draft the decision-criteria matrix and drop it in the MAP. Moving forward we should get Marcus on a 15-min call to align on KPIs.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Data ingestion complete: 2026-12-10 (owner: ShopNexa eng) — data validation checklist.
- Canary run: 2026-12-17 to 2026-12-18 (owner: Ben) — 10% traffic, 48-hour validation window.
- Initial evaluation: 2026-12-24 (owner: Marcus/Elena) — KPI review vs baseline.
- Final review & procurement signoff: 2027-01-07 (owner: Procurement) — contract + SOW.
